description: Most people walk past a grimy playground slide or a dirt-caked park bench without a second thought. Cho Hee-jae stops to see if it needs cleaning. Since May, the 30-year-old has spent his spare time traveling across Seoul and northern Gyeonggi Province to scrub apartment playgrounds and other public facilities, paying for the work himself. “I would pass dirty playgrounds and other public facilities and think, ‘I wish someone would clean those,’” Cho said in an interview with The Korea Herald on
title: This playground angel keeps Seoul’s slides sparkling

description: North Americans have become the fastest-growing foreign customer base at GS25, the South Korean convenience store chain operated by GS Retail, trailing just behind the dominant customer base of people from Greater China.
